decision: NOT A DROP-IN REPLACEMENT: sampled economic parity can support a separately versioned log-native evidence contract; current per-transaction transfer/compiled-identity requirements still need full transactions.

documentationReview.conflict: Official current main IDL omits final quote_transfer_fee u64 from Buy/Sell/Deposit/Withdraw events; instructions/accounts/discriminators match pinned SDK2.2.0. Captured matched events exactly require the pinned fee field, so the documented IDL must not silently replace verified bytes or invent missing fee zeros.
documentationReview.legacy24Conclusion: Two recorded successful buy instructions contain exactly discriminator+two u64s. A narrow decoder may preserve these actual two fields and mark absent track_volume unavailable, analogous to existing exact-quote compatibility; all event/transfer/scope checks remain necessary.
documentationReview.tail26Conclusion: Current official interface does not establish meaning of extra 0101 tail. Preserve refusal; no automatic OptionBool padding or arbitrary trailing-byte acceptance.

selection.method: Exact same signature+mint population/order frozen in linked baseline audit. All settled pilot intervals, deduplicate signature+mint, retain first observed direct/routed side combination, then refusal cases, then chronological remainder; maximum100 scoped transactions. Activity-biased transport/field sample, not market coverage/performance.

burst17.warning: 204/min is an instantaneous17/5s demand equivalence, not a sustainable allowance. Actual starts may be fewer because pacing, delay, occupancy, audit/protection share the gate.

capacity.logNativeProjectionCondition: Only after adopting a validated versioned event contract. Subscription management, notification bytes, independent coverage audits, support reads, protection and bounded fallbacks remain; zero enrichment is not zero RPC or verified capacity.
